newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK FINMIN SETS ONE-YR BOND AUCTION FOR JULY 8.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK FINMIN SETS ONE-YR BOND AUCTION FOR JULY 8.

text.p: The Slovak Finance Ministry will auction an unspecified tranche of one-year state bonds on July 8, the central bank said in a statement on Wednesday.
The bonds, which have a nominal value of 100,000 crowns each, carry a fixed annual coupon of 11.00 percent.
The ministry has held six auctions of one-year state bonds this year -- three of which were succesful -- offering a fixed coupon of 10.00 percent.
In the last auction on June 17, the ministry rejected all 540 million crowns worth of bids.
In the last successful auction of one-year state bonds on May 27, average yield rose to 15.868 percent from 14.88 percent in the previous auction of similar bonds on March 25.
The ministry does not set the amount of state securities offered at its custions, nor does it set a minimum or maximum limit price on bids.

State bonds and ministry's treasury bills are the main tolls to cover state budget deficit, which totalled 4.692 billion crowns in the first four months of this year, up from 3.450 billion in the first quarter.
